page.title: Activity log
page.subtitle: Who changed what and when in CRM and the Platform. Entries are read-only: they cannot be edited or deleted.

empty.title: No entries yet
empty.text: Every change will appear here: who granted a role, reset a password, or changed settings or a connection, with date and time.

noMatch.title: No entries match these filters
noMatch.text: Change the author, action or period, or reset the filters.

loadError.title: Could not load the log
loadError.text: The log is kept by CRM. Retry; if the error persists, check CRM in Settings · Connections.

card.title: Log entry
card.hint: Select an entry in the log to see the details here: who, when, and what exactly changed.
card.notFound: Entry not found on this page
card.noChanges: This action does not record before and after values.

role.nothing: The role content did not change.

roleJournal.title: Journal of role “{{name}}”
roleJournal.label: Role changes
roleJournal.hint: Who changed the role, when, and what. Entries are read-only.
roleJournal.emptyText: System roles come from the Platform catalog and never change. For a role created by an administrator, its creation and every save will appear here.
roleJournal.error: Could not load the role journal
roleJournal.errorText: The journal is kept by CRM. Retry.

resetPassword.title: Password reset
resetPassword.method: How to deliver the new password
resetPassword.step1: The employee will get an email at {{email}} with a new temporary password; the old password stops working.
resetPassword.step2: All their sessions in the Platform, CRM and ERP will end.
resetPassword.step3: On sign-in they must change the password; until then their status is “Invited”.
resetPassword.self: You cannot reset your own password here: choose “Change password” in the avatar menu.
resetPassword.sent: An email with the new password was sent to {{email}}

errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: Mail is not connected, the password is unchanged. Connect mail in Settings · Connections and retry.
errors.SECRETS_KEY_MISSING: The server has no secrets encryption key: the email cannot be sent. Set it in the server settings.
errors.SELF_RESET: You cannot reset your own password here: choose “Change password” in the avatar menu.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Not enough rights: passwords are reset by an administrator.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Employee not found. Refresh the list.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: CRM is not responding. The password is unchanged, retry later.
errors.DEFAULT: Could not reset the password. Please retry.

resetPassword.temporaryHint: No email: you see the new password once and hand it to the employee in person; the old one stops working.

profile.intro: Direct messages from the bot in Telegram: what you get and where.
profile.loadError: Could not load notification settings. Try again later.
profile.linkHint: An administrator links Telegram in the employee card (Settings · Employees). Until it is linked, subscriptions do not work.
profile.failed: The bot's last message was not delivered ({{time}}). Open the bot in Telegram, press Start, then send a test notification.
profile.leadsHint: The bot writes when a lead is handed to a manager or a client replies.
profile.systemHint: Integration and monitoring failures, for administrators.
profile.testHint: The bot sends you a test message in Telegram, so you can check that delivery works.

errors.NOT_LINKED: Telegram is not linked: ask an administrator to link it in the employee card.
errors.REFUSED: Telegram did not accept the message. Open the bot, press Start and make sure it is not blocked.
errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: The bot is not connected. An administrator connects it in Settings · Connections.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: CRM is not responding. Retry later.

lead.make_customer: Converted a lead to a client
lead.assign: Handed a lead to a colleague

user.reset_password_email: Reset a password and emailed it

client.erp_handoff: Requested a client re-handoff to ERP

model.reset: Reset an AI model to default
